card.name: The ium ending of gadolinium
card.fires_on: Mainly the final piece "ium" of the word gadolinium in gadolinium retention warnings for contrast agents. It also fires weakly on a few other words in dosing and preparation text.

modes.label: Gadolinium ending
modes.description: The last piece of gadolinium when it is split into parts, in retention warnings about contrast agents.
modes.example: Gadolinium Retention: Gadolin<<ium>> is retained for months or years in brain

modes.label: Scattered dosing words
modes.description: Occasional words in preparation or dilution text, such as concentration or a product name ending.
modes.example: to a final<< concentration>> between 0.075 mg
